name: error_rate_spike
description: Alerts on significant increase in 5xx error rates

query_condition.sql: SELECT count(*) as total, method, path, min(trace_id) as trace_ref FROM "default" WHERE service_name IN ('scribe-backend', 'scribe_backend') AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(status, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS INTEGER) >= 500 GROUP BY method, path HAVING count(*) > 20
